context: w1 fork preserving LICENSE and README credits chain (upstream is itself a fork of michaelhannecke/pi-container). w2 scripts/preflight.sh: Apple Silicon check, sw_vers >= 26, container --version >= pinned floor, live smoke (container network create preflight-int --internal; two containers ping each other; cleanup), PREFLIGHT_FORCE_OS env override so the negative path is testable. Anti-patterns: no git add -A; no edits to run.sh/Containerfile in this item; repo is public so never commit tokens or hostnames beyond what upstream already exposes.
description: Fork https://github.com/0xKZ/pi-container (MIT, Zach Kehs) to ~/Developer/agent-container as the base for agent-agnostic sandboxed VM infra on the Mac Mini. This item ONLY forks and builds the gate script; no behavior changes. GATE RULE: the entire program is gated on the Mini running macOS >= 26 — on macOS 15 Apple container has no container-to-container networking, so the dual-homed egress design is impossible. If the Mini is on 15, STOP: write docs/alternatives.md recommending the Lima/Docker single-VM design and escalate to Joe instead of proceeding. Also warn (not fail) on macOS 26.1 publish bug apple/container#919.
